notes.title: 🎉 V1.0 — We Actually Did It
notes.description: After countless late nights, questionable design decisions, and more TypeScript than any human should endure — Emergent Energy Dashboard is officially Version 1. This isn't a beta. This isn't a preview. This is the real deal. Pop the champagne.

notes.title: Comprehensive Audit Logging
notes.description: Every click, change, update, and notification is now tracked across all functions and tables. Full history logging with user, timestamp, and change details — because accountability is the new black.

notes.title: PM On-The-Go Mode
notes.description: Mobile-first project management for site PMs. Log site visits, raise POs, track variations, report delays, escalate issues — all from the field. Includes compliance tracking for daily diaries and weekly progress.

notes.title: Excel Sync Acknowledgment System
notes.description: When project data changes, Construction Managers, Program Managers, and Finance Managers get notified to confirm they've synced the underlying Excel files. No more 'I didn't know it changed' excuses.

notes.title: Enhanced Roles & Permissions
notes.description: 11 permission categories with 60+ granular entity controls. Admins can fine-tune exactly who sees what, who edits what, and who approves what — down to the button level.

notes.title: EE Info Interactive Operating System
notes.description: Company-wide process map with lifecycle flows, network views, live metrics, and role-based simulation. Navigate the entire Emergent Energy operating system in one interactive dashboard.

notes.title: 5-Stage Engineering Checklist System
notes.description: Template-driven engineering stages from First Assessment through Handover Pack. Stage gating with COO override, deliverable tracking, and SharePoint integration for document management.

notes.title: Gamification & Leaderboard
notes.description: Badge and point system tracking user activity across 8 progression levels. Because everything is more fun when there's a scoreboard.

notes.title: Teams Chat & Collaboration Hub
notes.description: MS Teams-styled channel chat with department and project channels, file sharing, and a unified collaboration hub bringing SharePoint, approvals, and deliverables together.

notes.title: Interactive Onboarding & Screen Tours
notes.description: Context-aware walkthroughs and guided tours on every major page. New users get up to speed without reading a 200-page manual nobody wrote.

notes.title: 🥚 Easter Egg: The First Electron
notes.description: Legend has it, if you click this release note exactly 7 times, nothing happens. But you smiled, didn't you? That's the power of V1. Welcome to Emergent Energy — where electrons flow and so does the data. Here's to building the future, one solar panel at a time. ⚡
